scope: Read-only literature/catalogue audit; no maintained source changed, no contact/booking/equipment task.

Tang2010_constraints.spectral_class: K2III; luminosity-class uncertainty II-IV; I and V excluded
Tang2010_constraints.RV_variation: Not detected at ~8 km/s precision; not proof of singleness
Tang2010_constraints.color_constraint: No color change detected, but no red/yellow plates during1930-1940 major dip
Tang2010_constraints.object_confusions: 7sigma reddening and H-K=0.27 discussion are J0830;3sigma reddening and detected RV variability are J0736
Tang2010_constraints.mechanisms: J0754-specific irregular expelled layers obscuring star proposed, not established. Shared alternatives: lithium flash/RGB bump and helium-shell ignition/early AGB. Hydrogen absorption and absent strong carbon bands reject ordinary RCB classification; no symbiotic composite/nebular signatures.
Tang2010_constraints.derived_IR_color_caution: Single-epoch color by subtraction; not an established circumstellar dust excess.

nss_interpretation.caveat: High period confidence rejects Gaussian white-noise null; it is not probability the orbit/alias is physically correct. Intrinsic line-profile changes and blended spectra can mimic Doppler orbital motion. Not in gold selection does not establish a false orbit.
nss_interpretation.causal_limit: Even a validated35.92d companion would not itself establish the cause of multiyear fading.

atmosphere_caveats: GSPphot assumes single nonvariable star; temperature-extinction degeneracy and underestimated errors. Its mean AG is not a detection of variable circumstellar dust.
GSPspec flags character8=1 is extrapol flag; its logg4.84 lies above4.75 boundary in Recio-Blanco2023 TableC.5. This flags a grid-edge solution, not independent proof of a dwarf.

FLAME flag10 means giant mass/age caution and parallax-based luminosity. Official documentation recommends giant masses/ages only in1-2Msun and age>1Gyr; this target2.60Msun/.56Gyr lies outside recommendation.
Gaia proper motion differs markedly from Tang2010 Tycho-2(-3,-10.2mas/yr); rederive kinematics before retaining old thick-disk/old-low-mass argument.
The2010 spectral classification and Gaia atmosphere outputs need reconciliation; neither catalogue fit confirms shell-flash evolutionary state.

literature_search.bounded_result: No subsequent dedicated mechanism study located in these searches. Tang2012 dissertation chapter3 repeats discovery material. This is not an exhaustive absence claim.

inferred_discriminating_observations: Near-simultaneous multiband optical plus NIR/MIR photometry across bright/faint states: test reddening slope against photospheric temperature/spot models and look for excess thermal emission. Noncontemporaneous broad-band SED alone cannot identify time-variable dust.

High-resolution multiepoch spectra across35.92d and over slow fading: independent RV orbit, line-bisector changes, Teff/logg/metallicity, CaHK/Halpha activity,Li6708 and wind/circumstellar absorption; separate orbital motion from intrinsic line profiles and constrain shell-flash proposal.
Optical polarimetry during fading can test scattered-light geometry; absence of measured reddening or warm-IR growth would not exclude grey grains, cold dust or a small covering clump.
Photometric coherence at35.92d or17.96d would support an orbital/rotation connection but does not alone assign the multiyear fading mechanism.
